verses.text: I go sing of faithful love and justice. To you, Lord, I go sing praises.
I go behave wisely for perfect way. When you go come to me? I go waka inside my house with perfect heart.
I no go set anything wicked before my eyes. I hate di work of dem wey turn aside. E no go cling to me.
Perverse heart go dey far from me. I no go know evil.
Whoever secretly slander im neighbor, I go destroy am. I no go put up with person wey get proud look and arrogant heart.
My eyes go dey on di faithful of di land, so dat dem go dwell with me. Na di one wey waka for perfect way go serve me.
No deceitful person go dwell inside my house. No liar go stand before my eyes.
Every morning I go destroy all di wicked of di land, to cut off all di workers of iniquity from di city of di Lord.

chapters.title: A prayer of di afflicted, when e dey overwhelmed and pour out im complaint before di Lord.

verses.text: Hear my prayer, Lord. Make my cry come to you.
No hide your face from me for di day of my trouble. Bend your ear to me. For di day wey I call, answer me quick.
Because my days dey consume like smoke. My bones dey burn like furnace.
My heart dey struck like grass and dey wither, because I dey forget to eat my bread.
Because of di sound of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
I be like pelican of di wilderness. I be like owl of di waste places.
I dey awake, and I be like sparrow wey dey alone on di housetop.
My enemies dey reproach me all day. Dem wey rage against me dey use my name as curse.
Because I don eat ashes like bread and mix my drink with tears,
because of your indignation and your wrath, because you don lift me up and throw me down.
My days be like shadow wey dey stretch out. I dey wither like grass.
But you, Lord, dey enthroned forever. Your name dey to all generations.
You go arise and have mercy on Zion, because di time to show favor to am don come. Yes, di appointed time don come.
Because your servants take pleasure for im stones and favor im dust.
So di nations go fear di name of di Lord, and all di kings of di earth go fear your glory.
Because di Lord don build up Zion. E don appear for im glory.
E don consider di prayer of di destitute and no despise dem prayer.
Dem go write dis for di generation to come, so dat people wey never dey born go praise di Lord.
Because e don look down from im holy height. From heaven di Lord look di earth,
to hear di groans of di prisoner, to free dem wey dem don appoint to death,
so dat men go declare di name of di Lord for Zion and im praise for Jerusalem,
when di peoples gather together, and di kingdoms, to serve di Lord.
E don weaken my strength for di way. E don shorten my days.
I talk say, “My God, no take me away for di middle of my days. Your years dey through all generations.
Long ago you lay di foundation of di earth. Di heavens na di work of your hands.
Dem go perish, but you go remain. Yes, all of dem go wear out like cloth. You go change dem like clothing, and dem go change,
but you remain di same, and your years no go end.
Di pikin dem of your servants go continue. Dem offspring go dey established before you.”
Bless di Lord, my soul, and all wey dey inside me, bless im holy name.
Bless di Lord, my soul, and no forget all im benefits,
wey dey forgive all your iniquities, wey dey heal all your diseases,
wey dey redeem your life from di pit, wey dey crown you with faithful love and tender mercies,
wey dey satisfy your desire with good things, so dat your youth dey renewed like di eagle.
Di Lord dey work righteousness and justice for all dem wey dey oppressed.
E make im ways known to Moses and im deeds to di people of Israel.
Di Lord full of mercy and grace, slow to anger and plenty for faithful love.
E no go always dey rebuke, and e no go keep im anger forever.
E no deal with us according to our sins, nor repay us according to our iniquities.
Because as di heavens dey high above di earth, so great im faithful love dey toward dem wey fear am.
As far as di east dey from di west, so far e don remove our transgressions from us.
Like how papa dey have compassion on im pikin dem, so di Lord dey have compassion on dem wey fear am.
Because e know how we form. E remember say we na dust.
As for man, im days na like grass. As flower of di field, so e dey flourish.
Because di wind pass over am, and e don go, and im place no go know am again.
But di faithful love of di Lord dey from everlasting to everlasting on dem wey fear am, and im righteousness to pikin dem pikin,
to dem wey keep im covenant and remember im precepts to do dem.
Di Lord don establish im throne for di heavens, and im kingdom rule over all.
Bless di Lord, una im angels, una mighty ones wey do im word, wey obey di voice of im word.
Bless di Lord, all una im armies, una wey be im servants wey do im pleasure.
Bless di Lord, all im works, for all places of im dominion. Bless di Lord, my soul.
Bless di Lord, my soul. Lord my God, you dey very great. You dey clothe yourself with honor and majesty.
You cover yourself with light like garment. You stretch out di heavens like curtain.
You lay di beams of your rooms for di waters. You make di clouds your chariot. You dey waka on di wings of di wind.
You make winds your messengers, flames of fire your servants.
You set di earth on im foundations, so dat e no go ever shake.
You cover am with di deep like garment. Di waters stand above di mountains.
At your rebuke dem flee. At di voice of your thunder dem hurry away.
Dem go up di mountains, dem go down di valleys, to di place wey you don appoint for dem.
You set boundary wey dem no fit pass, so dat dem no go return to cover di earth.
E send springs into di valleys. Dem run among di hills.
Dem give drink to every animal of di field. Di wild donkeys quench dem thirst.
Di birds of di sky dey nest by dem. Dem dey sing among di branches.
E dey water di mountains from im rooms. Di earth dey satisfied with di fruit of your work.
E dey cause di grass to grow for di livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, so dat e go bring out food from di earth,
and wine wey dey make man heart glad, oil to make im face shine, and bread wey dey strengthen man heart.
Di trees of di Lord dey satisfied, di cedars of Lebanon wey e plant,
where di birds make dem nests. As for di stork, di fir trees na im house.
Di high mountains na for di wild goats. Di rocks na refuge for di rock badgers.
E appoint di moon for seasons. Di sun know im time to go down.
You make darkness, and e be night, when all di animals of di forest dey creep out.
Di young lions dey roar after dem prey and dey seek dem food from God.
Di sun dey rise, dem dey gather together and lie down for dem dens.
Man dey go out to im work and to im labor until evening.
Lord, how many your works dey! You don make dem all with wisdom. Di earth full of your riches.
Dere dey sea, big and wide, wey get countless things wey dey creep, both small and great animals.
Dere di ships dey go. Dere dey Leviathan, wey you don form to play inside am.
Dem all dey wait for you, so dat you go give dem dem food for di right time.
You give am to dem, dem gather am. You open your hand, dem dey satisfied with good.
You hide your face, dem dey troubled. You take away dem breath, dem die and return to dem dust.
You send out your Spirit, dem dey created, and you dey renew di face of di ground.
Make di glory of di Lord endure forever. Make di Lord rejoice for im works.
E look di earth, and e tremble. E touch di mountains, and dem smoke.
I go sing to di Lord as long as I dey alive. I go sing praise to my God while I still dey.
Make my meditation dey sweet to am. I go rejoice for di Lord.
Make sinners dey consumed out of di earth, and make di wicked no dey again. Bless di Lord, my soul. Praise di Lord.
Give thanks to di Lord. Call on im name. Make im deeds known among di peoples.
Sing to am, sing praises to am. Tell of all im wonderful works.
Glory for im holy name. Make di heart of dem wey seek di Lord rejoice.
Seek di Lord and im strength. Seek im face always.
Remember im marvelous works wey e don do, im wonders and di judgments of im mouth,
una offspring of Abraham im servant, una pikin dem of Jacob, im chosen ones.
Na im be di Lord our God. Im judgments dey for all di earth.
E remember im covenant forever, di word wey e command to 1,000 generations,
di covenant wey e make with Abraham and im oath to Isaac,
wey e confirm to Jacob for statute, to Israel as everlasting covenant,
say, “To you I go give di land of Canaan as di portion of your inheritance.”
When dem few for number, yes, very few, and strangers inside am,
wey dey waka from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,
e no allow anybody to oppress dem. Yes, e rebuke kings for dem sake,
say, “No touch my anointed ones, and no do my prophets wrong.”
E call for famine on di land. E break all di supply of bread.
E send man before dem. Dem sell Joseph as slave.
Dem hurt im feet with shackles. Iron enter im neck.
Until di time wey im word come true, di word of di Lord test am.
Di king send and free am, di ruler of peoples set am free.
E make am oga of im house and ruler over all im possessions,
to bind im princes as e like and teach im elders wisdom.
Israel come into Egypt. Jacob dey for di land of Ham as stranger.
E make im people very fruitful and make dem stronger pass dem adversaries.
E turn dem heart to hate im people and to deal craftily with im servants.
E send Moses im servant, and Aaron wey e don choose.
Dem do im signs among dem and wonders for di land of Ham.
E send darkness and make am dark. Dem no rebel against im words.
E turn dem waters to blood and kill dem fish.
Dem land produce frogs plenty, even inside di rooms of dem kings.
E speak, and swarms of flies come, and lice for all dem territory.
E give dem hail for rain and flaming fire for dem land.
E strike dem vines also and dem fig trees and break di trees of dem territory.
E speak, and locusts come, and young locusts without number,
and eat up all di plants for dem land and eat up di fruit of dem ground.
E strike also all di firstborn for dem land, di first of all dem strength.
E bring dem out with silver and gold, and no one among im tribes stumble.
Egypt glad when dem go, because di fear of dem don fall on dem.
E spread cloud as covering and fire to give light for night.
Dem ask, and e bring quails and satisfy dem with bread from heaven.
E open di rock, and water gush out. E run through di desert like river.
Because e remember im holy promise and Abraham im servant.
E bring out im people with joy, im chosen ones with singing.
E give dem di lands of di nations, and dem inherit di labor of di peoples,
so dat dem go keep im statutes and obey im laws. Praise di Lord.
Praise di Lord. Give thanks to di Lord, because e good, because im faithful love dey forever.
Who fit tell di mighty acts of di Lord, or declare all im praise?
Blessed na dem wey keep justice, wey do righteousness at all times.
Remember me, Lord, with di favor wey you show your people. Visit me with your salvation,
so dat I go see di prosperity of your chosen ones, rejoice for di gladness of your nation, and glory with your inheritance.
We don sin like our papa dem. We don do iniquity. We don do wickedly.
Our papa dem for Egypt no understand your wonderful works. Dem no remember di multitude of your faithful love, but dem rebel by di sea, even di Red Sea.
But e save dem for im name sake, so dat e go make im mighty power known.
E rebuke di Red Sea too, and e dry up. So e lead dem through di depths like di wilderness.
E save dem from di hand of di one wey hate dem and redeem dem from di hand of di enemy.
Di waters cover dem adversaries. None of dem remain.
Den dem believe im words. Dem sing im praise.
But dem quickly forget im works. Dem no wait for im counsel,
but dem crave for di wilderness and test God for di desert.
E give dem wetin dem ask for, but send leanness into dem soul.
Dem envy Moses too for di camp, and Aaron, di holy one of di Lord.
Di earth open and swallow Dathan and cover di company of Abiram.
Fire burn for dem company. Flame burn up di wicked.
Dem make calf for Horeb and worship di molten image.
Dem exchange dem glory for di image of ox wey dey eat grass.
Dem forget God wey save dem, wey do great things for Egypt,
wonderful works for di land of Ham, and awesome things by di Red Sea.
So e talk say e go destroy dem, if Moses im chosen one no stand before am for di breach, to turn im wrath away from destroying dem.
Yes, dem despise di pleasant land. Dem no believe im word,
but dem grumble for dem tents and no listen to di voice of di Lord.
So e lift up im hand to dem, say e go make dem fall for di wilderness,
and make dem offspring fall among di nations and scatter dem for di lands.
Dem join dem self to Baal Peor and eat di sacrifices of di dead.
So dem provoke am to anger with dem deeds, and plague break out among dem.
Den Phinehas stand up and execute judgment, and di plague stop.
Dem count am as righteousness for am, to all generations forever.
Dem make am angry too at di waters of Meribah, so dat e go bad for Moses because of dem,
because dem rebel against im spirit, and e speak rashly with im lips.
Dem no destroy di peoples, as di Lord command dem,
but dem mix with di nations and learn dem works.
Dem serve dem idols, and dem become snare to dem.
Yes, dem sacrifice dem sons and dem daughters to evil spirits.
Dem pour out innocent blood, di blood of dem sons and of dem daughters, wey dem sacrifice to di idols of Canaan, and di land dey polluted with blood.
So dem make dem self unclean with dem works and dem dey unfaithful for dem deeds.
Therefore di anger of di Lord burn against im people, and e hate im own inheritance.
E give dem into di hand of di nations, and dem wey hate dem rule over dem.
Dem enemies oppress dem, and dem dey subdued under dem hand.
Many times e rescue dem, but dem dey rebel for dem counsel and dey brought low for dem iniquity.
Even so e look on dem distress, when e hear dem cry.
E remember for dem im covenant and relent according to di abundance of im faithful love.
E make dem dey pitied by all dem wey carry dem captive.
Save us, Lord our God, and gather us from among di nations, so dat we go give thanks to your holy name and glory for your praise.
Blessed be di Lord, di God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. Make all di people talk say, “Amen.” Praise di Lord.
Give thanks to di Lord, because e good, because im faithful love dey forever.
Make di redeemed of di Lord talk so, wey e don redeem from di hand of di enemy
and gather from di lands, from di east and from di west, from di north and from di south.
Dem wander for di wilderness, for desert way. Dem no find city to dwell.
Hungry and thirsty, dem soul faint inside dem.
Den dem cry to di Lord for dem trouble, and e deliver dem out of dem distress.
E lead dem by straight way, so dat dem go go to city to dwell.
Oh make men give thanks to di Lord for im faithful love and for im wonderful works to di pikin dem of men!
Because e satisfy di longing soul and fill di hungry soul with good things.
Some sit for darkness and for di shadow of death, prisoners for affliction and iron,
because dem rebel against di words of God and despise di counsel of di Most High.
So e bring down dem heart with hard labor. Dem stumble, and nobody help.
Den dem cry to di Lord for dem trouble, and e save dem out of dem distress.
E bring dem out of darkness and di shadow of death and break dem chains apart.
Oh make men give thanks to di Lord for im faithful love and for im wonderful works to di pikin dem of men!
Because e don break di gates of bronze and cut di bars of iron in two.
Some dey foolish for dem rebellious way and dem iniquities, and dem dey afflicted.
Dem soul hate all kinds of food, and dem near di gates of death.
Den dem cry to di Lord for dem trouble, and e save dem out of dem distress.
E send im word and heal dem and deliver dem from dem destruction.
Oh make men give thanks to di Lord for im faithful love and for im wonderful works to di pikin dem of men!
Make dem offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and tell of im works with singing.
Some go down to di sea for ships, doing business for great waters.
Dem see di works of di Lord and im wonders for di deep.
Because e command and raise di stormy wind, wey lift up di waves.
Dem go up to di heavens, dem go down again to di depths. Dem soul melt because of trouble.
Dem reel and stagger like drunk man and dem wisdom finish.
Den dem cry to di Lord for dem trouble, and e bring dem out of dem distress.
E make di storm calm, so dat di waves of di sea dey still.
Den dem dey glad because dem quiet, so e guide dem to di haven wey dem want.
Oh make men give thanks to di Lord for im faithful love and for im wonderful works to di pikin dem of men!
Make dem exalt am too for di assembly of di people and praise am for di seat of di elders.
E turn rivers to wilderness and springs of water to thirsty ground,
fruitful land to salt waste, because of di wickedness of dem wey dey live dere.
E turn wilderness to pool of water and dry ground to springs of water.
Dere e make di hungry dwell, so dat dem go establish city to dwell.
Dem sow fields, plant vineyards and gather fruitful harvest.
E bless dem too, so dat dem multiply greatly, and e no allow dem livestock to decrease.
Again dem dey diminished and brought low through oppression, trouble and sorrow.
E pour contempt on princes and make dem wander for waste wey no get way.
Yet e lift di needy out of affliction and make dem families like flocks.
Di upright see am and dey glad, and all wickedness shut im mouth.
Whoever dey wise, make e pay attention to dis and consider di faithful love of di Lord.
